sys_user j ON j.user_id = h.deal_person_id WHERE 1 = 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT f.robot_alarm_id AS warn_id, f.alarm_time, f.alarm_name AS warn_content, f.robot_id AS deviceId, g.robot_name AS device_name, f.alarm_level, c.dict_note AS alarm_level_name, f.alarm_state AS conf_mode, e.dict_note AS conf_mode_name, 279 AS alarm_source, '机器人' AS alarm_source_name, 002 as std_mete_id, '无' as mete_name, '无' as image_path, f.deal_info, f.deal_type, h.dict_note as deal_type_name, f.deal_person_id, k.user_name as deal_person_name, f.deal_time FROM t_robot_alarm f LEFT JOIN t_dict_business c ON f.alarm_level = c.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON f.alarm_state = e.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_robot_info g ON f.robot_id = g.robot_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h on f.deal_type = h.dict_code mapper.select: SELECT a.countNum as '主设备', b.countNum as '机器人', d.countNum as '摄像机', (a.countNum+b.countNum+d.countNum) as '总告警数' FROM( (select count(*) as countNum from t_warn_info ) a, (select count(*) as countNum from t_robot_alarm ) b, (select count(*) as countNum from t_camera_alarm) d )

select dict_code as device_type, dict_note as device_type_name, (select COUNT(*) from t_std_device a,t_warn_info b where a.device_id = b.device_id and device_type = dict_code ) as c_ount from t_dict_business where dict_code in ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'device_type' ) ORDER BY c_ount desc

SELECT a.processed+b.processed+d.processed as '已处理', e.untreated+f.untreated+g.untreated as '未处理' FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_warn_info ) a, (select count(alarm_state = 275 or null) as processed from t_robot_alarm ) b, (select count(alarm_state = 275 or null) as processed from t_camera_alarm) d, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_warn_info ) e, (select count(alarm_state = 276 or null) as untreated from t_robot_alarm ) f, (select count(alarm_state = 276 or null) as untreated from t_camera_alarm) g )
